positionCoverageGaps.note: Not proof a starter is missing: historical 3-back / narrow midfield / wing-back may replace nominal position; match-by-match XI mapping pending.

explicitNominationSlotExceptions.reason: Historically multiple starting forwards rotate; up to 2 co-starting ST and 1 start-equivalent alternative; 2+1 tactical nomination exception

Both Gerber 6 starts and Carnell 7 starts are marked alternative: there is no evidence either occupied an unambiguous season-long first-choice LB role. Two backup-slot markers retained rather than inventing primary-starter status. Seitz 26 starts on left flank, LB vs LWB distinction open.
